item.title: Early deficit plagues Maryland in 8-3 loss to No. 1 UCLA, for second Big Ten series defeat
item.description: Defensive shortcomings impeded the Terps again Saturday, continuing a disappointing trend.

item.title: Shooting woes plague Maryland’s women’s basketball in 74-66 season-ending loss to North Carolina
item.description: The Terps shot 13 percent from distance, only hitting three 3-pointers on 23 attempts. Saylor Poffenbarger and Yarden Garzon went a combined 0-for-16.

item.title: Second-quarter surge powers No. 3 Maryland women’s lacrosse past USC, 13-7
item.description: The Terps managed just one goal in the opening quarter and two in the game’s final frame. But they scored a combined 10 in the middle two periods.

item.title: Maryland softball drops early lead in loss to Indiana, 7-2, for third Big Ten series defeat
item.description: The Terps were outplayed on all fronts by a conference opponent once again, giving up six uncontested runs in the final three innings.

item.title: Purple Line begins testing in College Park this week
item.description: During the first phase of testing, light rail vehicles will be tested overnight Tuesday through Friday.
